page_title: ALM 0-0 MAL | Almeria v Mallorca 17/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' Mallorca are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.

90+2' Javier Llabres (Mallorca) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Almeria will have a goal kick.

90+1' Sergio Arribas (Almeria) collects a cross from the free kick and unleashes a shot towards the goal. However, it isn't precise at all and the ball goes miles over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' A yellow card is awarded to Matija Nastasic (Mallorca).
88' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
85' It will be a substitution. Arnau Puigmal (Almeria) is ready to enter the pitch as Gonzalo Melero walks off.
84' Having seen unsporting behavior, Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Lucas Robertone (Almeria) is the recipient.
84' The Largie Ramazani (Almeria) turns away in celebration as the ball hits the net, but his joy is short-lived as referee Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes rules it out for a foul.
83' Leo Baptistao (Almeria) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
82' Luis Maximiano (Almeria) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
81' One of the Almeria players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lazaro (Almeria) replaces Adrian Embarba.
79' Wonderful movement by Almeria. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
76' Javier Aguirre has decided to substitute Sergi Darder and he is replaced by Amath Ndiaye (Mallorca).
75' Javier Aguirre has decided to make a change. Javier Llabres (Mallorca) replaces Pablo Maffeo.
75' Substitution. Cyle Larin will be replaced by Abdon Prats (Mallorca).
73' The referee is firm and issues Iddrisu Baba Mohammed (Almeria) a deserved yellow card.
71' The resulting set piece from Almeria is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
70' One of the Almeria players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul.
69' Mallorca keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
67' Almeria failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
65' A corner kick by Almeria is thwarted by the well prepared Predrag Rajkovic (Mallorca).
63' Samu Costa (Mallorca) was too forceful with his tackle and Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
62' Almeria are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
59' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Mallorca.
57' The referee allows time for a substitution. Antonio Sanchez will be replaced by Manu Morlanes (Mallorca).
57' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the area, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Almeria will have a goal kick.
55' The Almeria players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
53' Alejandro Pozo (Almeria) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
50' Mallorca are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
48' Almeria hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
46' Half-time substitution. Dion Lopy (Almeria) is replaced by Gonzalo Melero.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Gaizka Garitano probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Chumi (Almeria). He is replaced by Iddrisu Baba Mohammed.
46' Half-time substitution. Lucas Robertone (Almeria) will not participate anymore and Largie Ramazani is coming on.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+7' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+5' Leo Baptistao (Almeria) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went low towards the middle of the target, but Predrag Rajkovic was alert and the score remained the same.

45+4' The ball is laid off to Leo Baptistao (Almeria) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players low towards the middle of the goal and forces Predrag Rajkovic to make a decent save.
45+2' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
45' Almeria take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
44' Mallorca fail to score from a corner as Luis Maximiano (Almeria) leaps to collect the ball.

42' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Almeria.
41' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Cesar Montes (Almeria) and blew his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Mallorca.
40' Almeria are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

39' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and releases a quick shot that sails towards the bottom left corner. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper dives to make a stunning save.

36' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Samu Costa (Mallorca) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Luis Maximiano pulls off a comfortable save.
34' Chumi (Almeria) commits a rough foul. Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes stops the game and makes a call.
33' Javier Aguirre is forced to make a change. Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud.
32' Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
30' Leo Baptistao (Almeria) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
27' The shots on goal statistics – 0:0.
24' Mallorca work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
24' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag and Mallorca will take a corner.
22' Jaume Costa (Mallorca) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
22' Mallorca can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
19' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows his whistle. Dion Lopy (Almeria) commits a foul after dangerous play.

17' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
17' Handball by Samu Costa (Mallorca).
16' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Cesar Montes (Almeria).
13' Sergio Akieme (Almeria) is asking for medical treatment, but he will have to leave the pitch in order to receive help from the physio.
11' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) is being forced to leave the pitch in order to receive medical treatment and his team will play with a man short for a few minutes.
9' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) takes a wild swing at a rebound from mid-range and it goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Almeria.
8' What a big chance! Cyle Larin (Mallorca) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Almeria will have a goal kick.
7' The Mallorca players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
5' Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.

3' Dion Lopy (Almeria) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
2' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Mallorca was in an offside position.
2' Mallorca are ruled offside.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Mallorca will have the kick-off.
Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes will supervise the game today.
